history.event: Claude refinement: 53 line(s) suggested — Mostly garbled words in this ricordo of a son's birth and baptism, his godparents and later wet-nurses: names (lorenzo, nicholini, ridolfi, busini, maddalena), formulas (Richordo che, a ore x di notte, chonsalute dellanima, gluficiali di notte, ī chasa ꝓ balia, dare illatte) and the month gennaio; stray margin digits removed. | layout: l1: the final 'j' of the year (Lxvj) sits just outside the box on the right; l2: the end of dicēbre runs past the box on the right; l42: the leading '5' was the margin number '85' (left of the ruling); dropped; l54: the leading '9' was the margin number '93'; dropped; l57: tiny box around just the R-shaped money sign before l59 '5 la'; probably belongs to the same sum as l59 (and to l55's entry); l64: the box takes in a large empty area below the last line; l65: the box takes in an empty area below the line; it holds only the sum at the end of the last line; l40, l59, l65: sums in the right-hand column that belong to the entries on lines l39, l55 and l64 | doubts: l1: the first numeral letter looks like d, not m (expected mccccºLxvj); left as written; l4: 24 Dec 1466 (Julian) was a Wednesday, so I read 'venendo' (going into the 24th) rather than 'venerdi'; check; l12, l51: 'lianzia' is probably licenzia; I could not read the rest of l12 with confidence (left unchanged); l13, l17: 'del mone' with a flourish; monte (ufficiali del Monte) fits but is not certain; l14: last word looks like viuendo/ viuedo; unsure; l23: 'mo ꝓ surdre' in the image; I could not resolve it, so Kraken left; l27, l32, l39, l64: could not read with confidence, left unchanged; l40, l57, l63, l65: the R-shaped money sign (ƒ? lira?) and the sign 'tt' (⫳?) in l41/l45/l47/l52/l65 have no convention yet for MS 1321; Laura to decide; l34, l46, l56: written 'ge' + stroke + 'naio'; rendered gennaio; l56: the numeral could be xi; left as x (numerals not changed); l47: 'ß vii dbi' unclear (perhaps ß vij d vj); left unchanged
